description: Second held-out set of synthetic meetings for the notes variant eval, written blind to the summarizer and verifier source. People, organisations and products are invented. The meetings mix conditional agreements, unconditional commitments in the same sentence, spoken recording or agenda labels, product names that look like first names, restricted and unrestricted prices or quantities, adjacent counts with different subjects, suggestions and questions that are not tasks, negated commitments and decisions, a spoken date correction, and completed statuses. Agenda numbering inside labels is not a quantity.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Quarterly sync. We agreed to renew the Marlowe license on the 9th if finance signs the order form, and Joren will update the seat count.

segments.speaker: Joren
segments.text: I'll update the seat count by Friday. Right now we use 48 seats.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Quarterly sync. Quillon offered $40 per user per month for Marlowe, only with a two-year term. The onboarding package is a flat $1,200.

segments.speaker: Pilar
segments.text: Could we ask Quillon for a nonprofit discount? I'm only asking, I'm not taking that on.

segments.speaker: Joren
segments.text: I will email the Quillon account manager about the renewal terms on Tuesday.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Quarterly sync. The security audit is already done. We have not approved the extra storage tier.

segments.speaker: Bram
segments.text: Agenda item one, inventory: Cleo counted 340 pallets in the north bay. Dara scanned 85 returns.

segments.speaker: Cleo
segments.text: Agenda item two, staffing: we need 6 extra pickers for the holiday peak. The temp budget is $18,500.

segments.speaker: Dara
segments.text: I'll post the picker job ads on Tuesday once Bram approves the budget.

segments.speaker: Dara
segments.text: Correction: Thursday, not Tuesday.

segments.speaker: Bram
segments.text: I won't approve the budget until Cleo sends the shift plan.

segments.speaker: Cleo
segments.text: I'll send the shift plan by the 14th.

segments.speaker: Bram
segments.text: Agenda item three, safety: the forklift inspection is already done.

segments.speaker: Fenna
segments.text: Space planning call. Northgate Commons can give us 12 desks, except on Fridays. The meeting room is ours for 3 hours a week.

segments.speaker: Gus
segments.text: We agreed to sign the desk agreement on April 3 unless the price changes, and Hiro will set up Odette for desk bookings.

segments.speaker: Hiro
segments.text: I'll set up Odette by Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Fenna
segments.text: I suggest we try standing desks too, but that's just an idea, not a task for anyone.

segments.speaker: Gus
segments.text: Space planning call. I won't give out the door keys until Hiro finishes the Odette setup.

segments.speaker: Hiro
segments.text: The fire safety walkthrough is already done. We have not approved the parking spaces.

segments.speaker: Ivo
segments.text: Board prep. Project Wren reached 1,900 households this year. The volunteers logged 260 hours.

segments.speaker: Kenji
segments.text: The Wren grant budget for next year is $72,000. That plan also covers 2 field coordinators.

segments.speaker: Lior
segments.text: I'll submit the grant report on Tuesday only if Maren signs the budget page.

segments.speaker: Maren
segments.text: Correction: Lior submits the report on Thursday, not Tuesday. I'll sign the budget page after Kenji checks the totals.

segments.speaker: Ivo
segments.text: I want to ask whether we should mention the new van in the report. It's only a question, not a task.

segments.speaker: Kenji
segments.text: I'll check the totals by Monday. The volunteer survey is already done.

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: Launch review. We agreed to release Tobin on the 22nd once the payment test passes, and Oskar will write the release notes.

segments.speaker: Oskar
segments.text: I'll write the release notes by Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Tali
segments.text: Launch review. Pricing: the student plan is $9 a month only with a school email address. The standard plan is $15 a month.

segments.speaker: Oskar
segments.text: I suggest we add a family plan later, but nobody needs to act on that now.

segments.speaker: Tali
segments.text: I will update the pricing page on Friday if Nadia approves the copy. I won't announce the price until the payment test passes.

segments.speaker: Nadia
segments.text: We have not approved the Android version. The accessibility review is already done.

segments.speaker: Quinn
segments.text: Festival committee. We agreed to book the stage crew for May 18 if the council grants the permit, and Rhea will draft the volunteer rota.

segments.speaker: Sami
segments.text: Correction: we book the stage crew for May 19, not May 18.

segments.speaker: Rhea
segments.text: I'll draft the rota by Saturday.

segments.speaker: Theo
segments.text: Festival committee. Logistics: each stall gets 2 power outlets, except the food trucks. The site has 30 picnic tables.

segments.speaker: Quinn
segments.text: Theo signed up 18 volunteers last week. Rhea confirmed 24 stalls.

segments.speaker: Sami
segments.text: Could someone check whether the park has shade tents? I'm just asking, it's not an action yet.

segments.speaker: Theo
segments.text: I won't order the wristbands until the permit arrives, and I'll print the site maps after Rhea finishes the rota.

segments.speaker: Quinn
segments.text: The insurance renewal is already done. We have not approved the fireworks.
